name.en: East-west ballasted flat-roof frame with base troughs and ballast trough (BayWa r.e. novotegra type)
name.es: Estructura lastrada este-oeste para cubierta plana con bandejas base y bandeja de lastre (tipo BayWa r.e. novotegra)

description.en: Base elements (troughs) lie on the flat roof without penetration and are ballasted with a ballast trough. Connector sets and crossbars join the base elements into a frame; module supports at 10 degrees elevation carry the modules in landscape in an east-west layout. Middle and end clamp sets, cable channel and edge closure complete the system. Reference family: BayWa r.e. Flachdach III / novotegra 'The shortcut' flat-roof system.
description.es: Elementos base (bandejas) se apoyan sobre la cubierta plana sin perforarla y se lastran con una bandeja de lastre. Juegos de conexión y travesaños unen los elementos base en un bastidor; soportes de módulo a 10 grados de elevación sujetan los módulos en apaisado en disposición este-oeste. Garras intermedias y de extremo, canal de cables y cierre de borde completan el sistema. Familia de referencia: BayWa r.e. Flachdach III / novotegra 'The shortcut'.

typical_use: Flat roofs (0 to 5 degree pitch) with ballast, east-west orientation, no roof penetration; may be anchored to a parapet against creep.
applicable_standards: EN 1991-1-4 (wind actions, designer; ballast derived per project by the supplier according to the manual)
EN 1999-1-1 (aluminium design, designer; not verified in this research)
